releaseNotes: 🔒 Synchronized Firebase Anonymous Authentication: Resolved startup race condition with coroutine Mutex deduplication and persistent session reuse across launches.
👥 Listen Together Lifecycle Hardening: Strictly verified Firebase UID ownership for hosts and participants with elimination of random UUID fallbacks.
🧹 Spark Plan Inactive Room Cleanup: Automated host-driven inactive room garbage collection operating within free Spark plan quotas with zero Cloud Functions.
🛡️ Truthful Error Classification: Granular diagnostic reporting separating network timeouts, App Check rejections, and Firestore security rule boundaries.
⚡ Official Firestore Emulator Verification: Formally verified against Google Local Emulator Suite with 60/60 passing security rule assertions.
